articles.description: Starověká tělesa optikou informatiky. Temná hmota a temná energie mohou být pouze kosmickou iluzí. Na Marsu byl asi i dávný oceán.
articles.title: Týden na ScienceMag.cz: Jak souvisí krystaly křemíku s kosmickými strunami?

articles.author: Reklama
articles.description: Halloween je tady a s ním i strašidelné ceny za software! Tak neváhejte a kupte Windows 11 CDkey jen za €20.00 nebo Windows 11 Home Professional od Goodoffer24.com a budete připraveni s novým operačním systémem bez obav že byste nemohli pracovat a hrát si, protože na Goodoffer24 můžete koupit také hry nebo aplikace Office.
articles.title: Neděste se upgradu: Windows 11 Pro na Halloween jen za €20.00 na Goodoffer24

articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: Česko získalo svou továrnu na umělou inteligenci a s ní i nový AI superpočítač. Ransomware zasahuje nejen firemní data, ale i morálku zaměstnanců. Huawei na summitu v Mnichově: Wi-Fi nové generace a datová centra s nepřetržitým provozem. Novinky HP pro efektivní hybridní prostředí. České firmy využívají AI méně než slovenské. Pět klíčových kyberbezpečnostních výzev středoevropského finančního sektoru.
articles.title: Týden na ITBiz: Česko získalo svou továrnu na umělou inteligenci a s ní i nový AI superpočítač

articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: V kvantovém světě by mohly existovat i antagonistické interakce . Ani bosony, ani fermiony – fyzikové našli novou třídu částic. Dočkáme se průletové mise kolem mezihvězdné komety? Máme šanci pozorovat závěrečnou explozi primordiálních černých děr?
articles.title: Týden na ScienceMag.cz: ChatGPT řeší starořecký problém zdvojnásobení obsahu čtverce

articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: Přehled zářijových vydání Jaderných novin: stav vydání jádra, citáty týdne a seznam článků týkajících se jádra.
articles.title: Jaderné noviny – přehled za září 2025

articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: Sestry v hospici díky umělé inteligenci tráví čas u pacientů místo u papírů. Malý model AI pomůže velkému přepínat mezi přirozeným jazykem a kódem. Datová suverenita se stává kritickým rizikem podnikání. Novinky v MSP platformě Acronis: širší možnosti pro backup a DR. MPO má na digitalizaci malých a středních podniků připravenu je 1 miliardu Kč. Objevili nový typ interakce excitonů a magnonů ve 2D magnetech.
articles.title: Týden na ITBiz: Malý model AI pomůže velkému přepínat mezi přirozeným jazykem a kódem

articles.description: Průzkum našel více skrytých supermasivních černých děr, než se očekávalo. Mohl život existovat i v atmosféře dávného Marsu? Efekt motýlích křídel bývá často nepochopen.
articles.title: Týden na ScienceMag.cz: Novým kandidátem na temnou hmotu je gravitino

articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: Bezpečnostní rizika provozního IT – problém je hlavně historický. Vzdělávací sektor v boji s ransomwarem posiluje, týmy IT to však stojí hodně úsilí. AI agenti v podnicích rostou rekordním tempem. Když energii řídí algoritmus. Pětivrstvý grafen se přepíná mezi více supravodivými stavy.

articles.title: Steve Jobs a superpočítač Cray-1 na pamětních jednodolarových mincích

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Byl zveřejněn průběžně aktualizovaný program konference OpenAlt 2025 o otevřeném softwaru a datech, IT bezpečnosti, DIY a IoT. Konference proběhne o víkendu 1. a 2. listopadu v prostorách FIT VUT v Brně. Vstup je zdarma.
articles.title: Program konference OpenAlt 2025 zveřejněn

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Senát včera opětovně nepřijal návrh ústavního zákona, který měl do Listiny základních práv a svobod zakotvit právo občanů platit v hotovosti nebo být off-line. Návrh předložila skupina senátorů již v roce 2023. Senát dnes návrh neschválil, ale ani nezamítl. Pokud by ho přijal, dostala by ho k projednání Sněmovna a vyjádřila by se k němu vláda.
articles.title: Návrh zakotvit právo platit v hotovosti a být off-line Senát neschválil

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: V programovacím jazyce Go naprogramovaná webová aplikace pro spolupráci na zdrojových kódech pomocí gitu Forgejo byla vydána ve verzi 13.0 (Mastodon). Forgejo je fork Gitei.
articles.title: Forgejo 13.0

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Společnost Eclypsium se na svém blogu rozepsala o bezpečnostním problému počítačů Framework. Jedná se o zranitelnost v UEFI umožňující útočníkům obejít Secure Boot.
articles.title: Bezpečnostní problém počítačů Framework

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara

ARC Raiders release time and date 


ARC Raiders comes out on Oct. 30 on the PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series S and X. That puts it just about two weeks ahead of this article, with a full-blown open beta running between Oct. 17 and 19. ARC Raiders will not be a free-to-play experience, and instead charge a AA price of $40, which is a great way for developers to make a profit off their efforts as well as a means to curb cheating. 


The countdown below will tick down to Oct. 30 at 12am CT, since official, exact release times are yet to be revealed. We will update the countdown with additional relevant information as it becomes available. In the meantime, this should give you a general sense of how far away the game's launch is. 




ARC Raiders is an extraction shooter with both PVP and PVE elements, focusing on giving players a high-stakes, high-tension experience that is starkly different to most other games in the genre. It's one of the most anticipated titles of 2025, and bound to be a smash hit once it does launch later in October.

To access the ARC Raiders server slam on Steam, simply navigate to the game's Steam page and press "Request Access" on the playtest. Once you've done so, you'll be automatically let in, allowing you to download the game from your Steam library just like any other title. 


For Xbox Series S and X, and the PlayStation 5, accessing the beta is done by downloading the game from the relevant store, much like you would other games in your library. ARC Raiders has an official Discord server where you can communicate directly with the amazing team behind it, share your thoughts with them, or report any bugs and issues related to your playtest access. 


If all goes smoothly, you'll be having one of the best gaming weekends ever, guaranteed!

Maxing out Friendship Levels in Pokémon Legends Z-A is key if you want to improve your party members.


Whenever you want to evolve any Pokémon, you'll have to ensure that the Friendship Level is high enough. If that doesn't happen, you won't be able to evolve your Pokémon. While you can raise the Friendship level in-game by doing any activity, you'll want to be as efficient as possible.


How to max Happiness quickly in Pokémon Legends Z-A


The method I have used for the optimum rate of gaining Friendship Level requires the use of the Soothe Bell. While you can go without that item, we are talking about the fastest method possible, so it's worth doing the extra grind to obtain it. It will require you to clear a fair bit of side missions, so keep that in mind.


Screenshot by Destructoid


Once you get it, equip the Soothe Bell to a Pokémon. Then take it to a cafe of your choice and drink. Repeat this method four times, and it should automatically raise the Friendship to the maximum possible. This will automatically allow you to evolve it. Repeat the process as many times as you want, and should be able to evolve your party in no time.


There are a few occasions when four visits aren't enough. Just go to the cafe one more time, and it should get the job done. This method has already been tested with as many Pokémon as I could potentially use in my party, and it works like a charm at all times.


This method also reduces the need to know the Friendship Level you have with a specific Pokémon. If you still want to know about that, you can always visit the Friendship Checker lady in Lumiose City. She can be found at Café Pokémon-Amie, in the northwest part of town.

Find Beldum inside Lysandre Lab. Screenshot by Destructoid.


Beldum is inside Lysandre Labs, northeast of Wild Zone 7 in the Magenta Sector. You unlock this area by naturally progressing through the Legends ZA Main Story, when you have the "Reaching Rank A" mission. You will find that Lysandre Café actually hides that lab inside.


The lab room you'll find Bledum is to the center left of the lab. Use the mini-map to navigate.



When you enter the building, go to the left through the door. 


Keep going to the left in the room colored green on the minimap until you take an exit south.


Go left and go through the north door towards a corridor.


Take the first door left in that corridor, and you'll find a room full of Beldum.



Beldum's location inside Lysandre Labs. Screenshot by Destructoid


All the Beldum inside are wild spawns, which means you can try and Shiny hunt them if you want. The best method is probably entering and exiting the lab multiple times, because doing so will reset the spawns and make new Beldum show up, with another shot of rolling a shiny.


Once you evolve your Beldum into Metang and Metagross, you can get a Metagrossite Mega Stone for 360 Mega Shards to equip it and Mega Evolve your Metagross in battle.


If you don't want to wait that long to get a Beldum, your only choice is to have one given to you via trade with a friend who already has Lysandre Labs unlocked. Then, you need to check that the Beldum's level is below the one which Pokémon will listen to your orders. You can verify that in the Save menu.

In Pokémon Legends: ZA, large swaths of Lumiose City are blocked off by various hazards. One of the most troublesome issues is a purple sludge that clogs the streets, cutting you off from rare Pokémon, special items, and even side-mission progression.


What makes the purple goo so obnoxious is the fact that it's not immediately clear what type of Pokémon move is effective against it. But once you know its weakness, purple goop will become a minor roadblock on your journey to dominate the Z-A Royal.


How to clear the purple goo in Pokémon Legends: ZA


Screenshot by Destructoid


Water-type moves are the most reliable way to deal with purple sludge. I tried out a few different Water-type moves, and based on my findings, any Water-type move will clear up the sludge.


If you picked a Totodile like I did, clearing out purple goo won't be much of an issue. If you choose Chikorita or Tepig, you'll have to catch a Water-type Pokémon if you want to get past the slime. Luckily, the Pokédex in Pokémon Legends: ZA is full of solid Water-types. One of the best places to grab a Water-type is Wild Zone 2, which is home to Magikarp, Binacle, and Staryu. You could also pick up a Froakie by completing "A Challenge from Froakie" side mission.


Screenshot by Destructoid


Water-type moves aren't the only way to deal with purple sludge. Psychic-type moves can also blast it away, which makes sense: Psychic-type moves are super-effective against Poison-type Pokémon. A free Ralts is currently available through Mystery Gift until Feb. 26, 2026, but you can also catch an Abra in Wild Zone 5.


If you want a rundown of all the places you can find Water and Psychic-type Pokémon, check out our Wild Zone breakdown here. Once you're armed with the power of water and/or psionics, purple goo won't keep you from grabbing the Revitalizing Root for Fennekin or exploring the underbelly of Lumiose City.

The Soothe Bell is arguably one of the most important things to find in Pokémon Legends Z-A, and more so if you're aiming to raise the Friendship Level of your Pokémon quickly.


In Legends ZA, raising the Friendship Level for some Pokémon is key if you want to evolve it. While having the Soothe Bell isn't compulsory and you can complete a playthrough without it, having the item makes the whole process quicker.


If you've yet to find the item, this guide will ease your hunt.


Table of contents
How to get the Soothe Bell in Pokémon Legends Z-A
How does the Soothe Bell work in Pokémon Legends Z-A?


How to get the Soothe Bell in Pokémon Legends Z-A


The Soothe Bell is part of the side quest no. 36. Titled Some Friendly Competition, you'll have to complete the quest to earn the item. To obtain Soothe Bell, you'll have to reach the Cafe Rouleau in the southwestern part of the map.


Screenshot by Destructoid


Take the main path that leads to the southwest part of the map. Cafe Rouleau will fall to your right in the game. You'll find the lady in the location (as in the cover image). You'll need to defeat her to complete Some Friendly Competition.


How does the Soothe Bell work in Pokémon Legends Z-A?


The Soothe Bell enhances the rate at which the Friendship Level of your Pokémon goes up. You can do so by assigning the item to a Pokémon of your choice. This will raise its Friendship Level quickly whenever you perform any activity.


Do note that the Soothe Bell doesn't automatically raise the Friendship Level. It simply enhances the rate at which Friendship Level rises for Pokémon. Once you have raised the level of one Pokémon, you can switch and give it to the next one to take its benefits.

You can get all the Kanto starters in Pokémon Legends ZA, but you will have to progress up until the very end of the Story Missions to see them. But you're in luck if you're a fan of Bulbasaur, Charmander, or Squirtle, as you can pick one of them in a side quest you can't miss quite early into the game. 


Here are the two methods to get the Kanto starters in ZA.


First method: Pick one during A Call from Mable


A nostalgic choice. Screenshot by Destructoid.


You can pick one of the three Kanto starters during Side Mission 022, "A Call from Mable." You unlock this side quest by progressing through the main story and getting Main Mission 08, "Reaching Rank V." After you defeat Lida, simply heal at a Pokémon Center, and Mable will call you, giving you the quest.


Head to the Pokémon Research Lab south of Lumiose and take the elevator to the Director's Office. When you arrive, Mable will let you pick one from Bulbasaur, Charmander, and Squirtle to keep, simple as that. When you make your choice, the Pokémon will join your party or be sent to your box at Lv. 5.


Regardless of your choice, the Pokémon will be shiny-locked. 


Second method: Catch 'em all in the endgame


Time to do some shiny hunting. Screenshot by Destructoid


If you want to catch the other Kanto starters you missed from Mable's quest, you need to finish Legends ZA. Once you complete the main story and the credits roll, you unlock the Wild Zone 20 in the center of Lumiose City, where the Prism Tower is. You can catch Charmander, Squirtle, and Bulbasaur in that area as wild spawns, which means you can also hunt for their shiny versions there. 


Stock up on Poké Balls, bring some strong Pokémon with you to take them down, and you should have all Kanto starters in your Pokédex easily. Then, to have all their Mega Evolutions available in combat, you must buy their Mega Stones from the Stone Emporium for 100,000 Poké Dollars each.

From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Record Labels Fire Back at Cox in $1B Supreme Court Piracy Case, Cite Termination ‘Hypocrisy’

From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.

Reports suggest a new blocking tactic and a new wave of 'fines' for end users. The piracy pressure cooker is in full effect, but clear signs of growing pushback could change the course of the game.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: LaLiga’s 360° Piracy Blitz, New Blocking Tactics & Fines, Meet Rising Disapproval

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
As the U.S. Supreme Court weighs the future of ISP liability lawsuits, one company is making a $100 million bet on the outcome. Grove Street Partners is trying to buy the "IP Litigation Assets" from the bankrupt estate of Redbox's parent company. The move could launch a new wave of high-stakes lawsuits against Internet providers. Grove Street says that the funding is already in place, but the company is also embroiled in a separate financial dispute.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Company Offers $100 Million for the Right to Sue ISPs Using Redbox’s Piracy Claims

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
The Alliance for Creativity and Entertainment and Thailand's Department of Special Investigation (DSI) have announced a multi-location enforcement operation targeting INWIPTV, an IPTV provider with a 13-year history. Thailand's efforts are likely to improve trade relations with the United States, including the country's removal from the USTR's Watch List.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Thailand Hits Premier League Pirates, Anticipates USTR Watchlist Removal

articles.author: nospam@scummvm.org (kelmer)
articles.description:
Halloween is creeping closer… and what better way to celebrate than with a brand new game ready for testing in ScummVM?
We’re thrilled to announce that Trick or Treat, a Halloween-themed 1994 point and click adventure by ACA Soft, is now ready for public testing in the latest ScummVM daily builds!
As with all new game engines added to ScummVM, we need your help to ensure everything runs smoothly before declaring it officially supported. Grab your copy of Trick or Treat, fire up the latest daily build, and see how it fares!
Please report any issues you encounter to our bug tracker, following our usual testing guidelines. Screenshots, save files, and detailed notes are always appreciated.
So light a pumpkin and get ready to test Trick or Treat this spooky season!
>
articles.title: Get ready for the season by testing Trick or Treat!

articles.author: nospam@scummvm.org (mduggan)
articles.description:
We are happy to announce that Tex Murphy 2: Martian Memorandum is now ready for testing in ScummVM.
Martian Memorandum is the second game in the Tex Murphy  series, set in a dark version of the future circa 2039. You play private investigator Tex Murphy, who has been hired by the founder of TerraForm Corporation, Marshall Alexander, to locate his missing daughter Alexis. It seems like it might be a simple kidnapping, but the clues quickly lead to a much bigger mystery.
This is the second game in ScummVM using the Access Software engine – the first, Amazon: Guardians of Eden, was added nearly 10 years ago.
To test Martian Memorandum you’ll need the game files (available from GOG or Steam) and a daily development build. Be sure to check the notes on the wiki for the game, and please report any bugs on our issue tracker.
>
articles.title: “We’ve got a new case and you won’t believe who it involves!"

articles.author: nospam@scummvm.org (Helco)
articles.description:
Dr. Bacterio has a new invention, and it's your job to test it. Work your way through classic Hollywood films while somehow finding the time to save the real world from the mummy.
Whether you have the Spanish Mortadelo y Filemón: Aventura de Cine Edición especial or the German Clever & Smart: A Movie Adventure (check out the demo here), the daily build will transport you to the world of Film Noir in no time. The ScummVM Team would be grateful for any feedback you could share on your journey to meet Billy the Kid or Freddy Krueger.
Just a quick reminder that the Steam version has English subtitles for players who don't speak Spanish or German.
Before you start your test run, please read through our testing guidelines and take some screenshots along the way.
Now don't let the Super wait!
>

Pokračování má také naprosto nesmyslný náhodný děj (hodně připomínající libovolné pokračování "Noční můry v Elm Street"), ale velmi překvapivě (vzhledem ke stejnému režisérovi) mu chybí většina té působivé atmosféry, některé scény jsou nechtěně vtipné (strašidelné mrtvé děti za sklem) a film je delší, takže se všechno mnohem víc vleče. (Ilča 30 %)
articles.title: Recenze: Černý telefon 2 [Black Phone 2] - 50 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: "Pocitový" film s dobře fungující atmosférou a výbornými herci, kterému podráží nohy extrémní délka a extrémní pomalost všeho, co se v něm děje. Při třetím pomalém švenkování po stejné černobílé fotografii jsem zažíval téměř psychoteror a po 90 minutách jsem vážně uvažoval, že odejdu ze sálu. Námět je v mnoha ohledech podobný filmu "Hodiny" (2002), takže pokud vám ten připadal příliš komerční a přímočarý, "Pohled do slunce" zahraje na vaši artovou notu. (Ilča 40 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Pohled do slunce [In die Sonne schauen] - 40 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Poměrně originální hororově komediální variace, ze které bych byl znatelně nadšenější, kdybych pár měsíců předtím neviděl film Substance (který je výrazně nápaditější a lépe natočený). (Ilča 50 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Ošklivá sestra [Den stygge stesøsteren] - 60 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Místy úderný videoklip s fajn vizuály a hudbou. Žádná z postav mě ale nezaujala. Scénář je velmi špatný, ignorující většinu potenciálně zajímavých zápletek a v různých ohledech odporující předchozím filmům, i když na ně výslovně odkazuje. Disney bohužel "zprznil" odkaz původního Trona podobně jako to udělal se Star Wars. (Ilča 50 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Tron: Ares - 50 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Potenciálně zajímavý námět, který bohužel shazuje špatný scénář, špatná režie a špatné skoro všechno ostatní. Ne tak úžasně špatné jako třeba "Kněžna Libuše", ale jenom "špatné" ve smyslu "nekvalitní a nezajímavé". Dlouho jsem nezažil, aby se mi 90 minut v kině takhle hrozně vleklo. Je to škoda, protože základní myšlenka byla zajímavá a herci se snažili. Specificky bych zdůraznil extrémně odbytou hudbu ve chvílích, které si přímo říkaly o silné hudební motivy. (Ilča 20 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Fichtelberg - 30 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Natočit magický realismus tak, aby fungoval, je extrémně těžké. Tenhle pokus klopýtá ve všech aspektech a pro kinofanouška je užitečné analyzovat tento film v kontrastu s "Hřištěm snů", které se zabývá podobnými tématy a dělá to mnohem lépe. (Ilča 30 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Velká odvážná nádherná cesta [A Big Bold Beautiful Journey] - 40 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Dohnali jsme si dva fajnové horory od Zacha Creggera. (Ilča oba 80 %)
articles.title: Audio dvojrecenze: Barbar [Barbarian] - 80 % / Hodina zmizení [Weapons] - 90 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Mírně experimentální, zručně natočený a výpravný film s kvalitními hereckými výkony. Kdyby byl ještě experimentálnější, byl bych radši.  (Ilča 60 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Franz - 80 %

articles.description:
It was discovered that .NET did not properly handle the creation of temporary
build time directories. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a
denial of service. (CVE-2025-55247)

It was discovered that .NET did not properly establish TLS sessions for
SMTP server connections. An attacker could use this issue to cause .NET
to use unencrypted connections. This issue only affects .NET versions 8.0
and 9.0. (CVE-2025-55248)

It was discovered that .NET inconsistently interpreted certain http
requests. An attacker could possibly use this to bypass a security feature
over a network. (CVE-2025-55315)
articles.title: USN-7822-1: .NET vulnerabilities

articles.description:
USN-7818-1 fixed vulnerabilities in Apache Subversion. This update provides
the corresponding update for Ubuntu 18.04 LTS, Ubuntu 20.04 LTS, Ubuntu
22.04 LTS, and Ubuntu 24.04 LTS.

Original advisory details:

 It was discovered that Apache Subversion incorrectly parsed control
 characters in filenames. An attacker could possibly use this issue to
 commit a corrupted revision to a repository, leading to a denial of
 service.
articles.title: USN-7818-2: Apache Subversion vulnerability

articles.description:
Andrew Walker discovered that Samba incorrectly initialized memory in the
vfs_streams_xattr module. An authenticated attacker could possibly use this
issue to obtain sensitive information. (CVE-2025-9640)

Igor Morgenstern discovered that Samba incorrectly handled names passed to
the WINS hook program. An attacker could possibly use this issue to execute
arbitrary code. (CVE-2025-10230)
articles.title: USN-7826-1: Samba vulnerabilities

articles.description:
USN-7824-1 fixed several vulnerabilities in Redis. This update provides
the corresponding update for Ubuntu 22.04 LTS.

Original advisory details:

Benny Isaacs, Nir Brakha, and Sagi Tzadik discovered that Redis incorrectly
handled memory when running Lua scripts. An authenticated attacker could use
this vulnerability to trigger a use-after-free condition, and potentially 
achieve remote code execution on the Redis server.
articles.title: USN-7824-3: Redis vulnerability

articles.description:
It was discovered that MuPDF incorrectly managed memory, resulting in a
memory leak. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial
of service. This issue only affected Ubuntu 18.04 LTS. (CVE-2018-1000036)

It was discovered that MuPDF could enter an infinite loop when parsing
certain PDF files. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a
denial of service. This issue only affected Ubuntu 18.04 LTS.
(CVE-2018-10289)

It was discovered that MuPDF incorrectly managed memory, possibly leading
to a segmentation fault. An attacker could possibly use this issue to
cause a denial of service. This issue only affected Ubuntu 18.04 LTS.
(CVE-2018-16647, CVE-2018-16648)

It was discovered that MuPDF contained a use-after-free vulnerability.
An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service.
This issue only affected Ubuntu 18.04 LTS and Ubuntu 20.04 LTS.
(CVE-2020-21896)

It was discovered that MuPDF incorrectly managed memory, resulting in a
memory leak. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial
of service or obtain sensitive information. This issue only affected
Ubuntu 20.04 LTS. (CVE-2020-26683)

Maxim Mishechkin, Vitalii Akolzin, Shamil Kurmangaleev, Denis Straghkov,
Fedor Nis'kov and Ivan Gulakov discovered that MuPDF incorrectly managed
memory under certain circumstances, leading to a double-free. An attacker
could possibly use this to cause a denial of service. This issue only
affected Ubuntu 16.04 LTS, Ubuntu 18.04 LTS and Ubuntu 20.04 LTS.
(CVE-2021-3407)

Xuwei Liu discovered that MuPDF may perform an out-of-bounds write under
certain circumstances. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause
a denial of service. This issue only affected Ubuntu 18.04 LTS and Ubuntu
20.04 LTS. (CVE-2021-37220)
articles.title: USN-7825-1: MuPDF vulnerabilities

certain circumstances. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause

operations. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial

Ubuntu 18.04 LTS, Ubuntu 20.04 LTS, Ubuntu 22.04 LTS and Ubuntu 24.04 LTS.

Ubuntu 22.04 LTS and Ubuntu 24.04 LTS. (CVE-2024-7055)
